remarks: *HIGHEST BEST BY TOMORROW, FRIDAY 13, 2026 -- 5 PM* Live your best, city life in this great little studio located in Redstone Manor in the heart of Glenbrook and downtown Stamford. Investor-friendly with a potential built-in tenant or great beginnings for a cozy spot for one's own. Top floor corner end unit, great studio layout with defined entry, combination room with sunlight and double exposures. Kitchen has max storage and a place for bar seating. Three closets total, one a walk-in with surplus dressing area. Windowed bathroom, good for ventilation. Heat, hot water, cooking gas and one parking spot included in common charges. Three block distance to super fun Bedford St, with all the nightlife and street festivals you can ask for. Stamford Town Center, Ferguson Library, train station close by, public bus directly across. Perfect crash pad for commuters and urban enthusiasts alike. Unit sold as is.
